evidence.quote: blood samples were drawn from 19 outpatients with CD and 14 outpatients with UC
the purified amplicons were used as a template for 16S V3–V4 amplicon sequencing

controls.types: non-template control carried from DNA extraction through sequencing

evidence.quote: A non-template control (NTC) was included from the DNA extraction and downstream of sequencing.
Contamination from the environment or reagents was detected in the NTC.

notes: Single NTC sequenced; no taxa removed. Probionibacterium (sic), Staphylococcus, Streptococcus, Rothia flagged because authors report them as shared with the NTC and contrast them with blood-only genera 'less likely' to be contamination (judgement call). Achromobacter dominant (63.8%) and authors say it may be contamination but leave it open - not flagged. Top-10 genera only in Fig. 2; Table S1 not available.
